row.title: DATAGRAPH-1: every system keeps a knowledge graph of all its data
row.body: Owner directive 2026-11-25. Built as core/datagraph (deterministic extraction from the data: rows are nodes, key-equal values and ids in text are edges), the seed tick step knowledge-graph (bi-temporal D1 storage, hash-diff writes, PageRank, communities, bridges, orphans, Adamic-Adar leads settled against later data, calibrated kind weights, KG-ORPHANS items), a privacy-gated read side (/api/graph*, /graph), and doctrine/knowledge-graph.json with foundation/datagraph.py --check covering every system. LLM extraction and Leiden are upgrade paths, not the default: schema-first extraction and topology heuristics are cheaper and competitive. Research: docs/research/knowledge-graph.md.
